newsitem.title: USA: Consolidated Eco sees FY loss of $4 mln.
newsitem.headline: Consolidated Eco sees FY loss of $4 mln.

text.p: Consolidated Eco-Systems Inc said Monday it expects to report a net loss for the year ended December 31, 1996, of about $4 million compared to a net profit of about $700,000 for the 1995 year.
First Call estimates were not available.

The company said the loss will include about $1.7 million for acquisition-related expenses, one-time fourth quarter adjustments to work in progress of about $1.1 million, about $375,000 of development stage expenses and a write-off of bad debts of about $570,000, the company said.
It said it expects total revenues for the year to be about $30 million, compared to about $21 million for the 1995 year.

The company said it has cut its work force by about ten percent so far in 1997, a move it said will bring annualized savings of about $3.1 million. It said it has also sold Larco's unprofitable marine spill and hazardous materials response business for about $1.2 million cash, which it said will cut annual operating expenses by at least $700,000.
The company said it plans to continue making personnel changes, cost cutting and controls and concentrate on its strategic core businesses.

"We will continue to focus on reducing general and administrative expenses and improving profit margins through cutting cost of sales and eliminating unprofitable services," the company said in a release.
Consolidated ECO, formerly known as Exsorbet Industries Inc, said it would file its annual report on or before April 15.
